sources.title: [2610.23374] MOSS-Image Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: On RLA, MOSS-Image ranks second in the end-to-end system comparison, while its backbone ranks first among generators evaluated with shared enhanced prompts. We will release the model, training recipe, and evaluation framework to support further research and promote the text-to-image community.
